picks.what: View over the town, steel engraving in Meyer’s Universum, vol. 6
picks.why: rooftop view across the town to the domed collegiate church (now the cathedral) and church towers; monks in the foreground; plate border and caption cut off

gaps: P0: only a sheet of music (Cantiga 371); P2: nothing; P4: only portraits and an 1892 execution scene; P5: nothing; P6: #11 (2012) is an over-processed HDR rooftop panorama with a watermark and a supermarket sign, #12–#13 suburbs seen from the hospital, all skipped
notes: #4 is a photo of the same Meyer’s plate in the bound book; #5 is the clean scan. The plate may be copied from David Roberts’s view of Xeres (1830s), so a reviewer may prefer an earlier date if that is confirmed. #3 (Anton van den Wyngaerde’s panorama, 1567, colored, 5141 px wide) is a fine true view, but P1 already has the 1575 Braun and Hogenberg plate, which reads more clearly at card size; not replaced, though it is a reasonable swap if the reviewer prefers the detailed drawn-on-site panorama.
